name: Functional Composition Obfuscation
description: Replaces a numerical adjacency constraint (sum of neighbors) with a functional composition constraint. By mapping the two valid states to mutually inverse, non-involutory functions (left and right cyclic shifts of a 3-element array), the requirement that adjacent nodes have different states is perfectly preserved. This forces the model to evaluate the compositions to discover that $s_u \neq s_v$, completely removing any graph coloring, parity, or arithmetic vocabulary that the surviving models rely on for pattern matching.
